item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Tshisekedi engaged in formal arms-control, inspection, nonproliferation, or disarmament policy in the nuclear sense. The only substantive material was about regional ceasefires, Luanda/Nairobi-style peace processes, and conflict de-escalation in eastern Congo. So the defensible conclusion is qualified support for de-escalation agreements, but limited proof of durable good-faith implementation because the process repeatedly stalled and fighting resumed.","evidence":[{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi Et Joao Lourenco appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-08-12","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au_respect_du_cessez_le_feu","summary":"Tshisekedi met with Angola’s president, who was mediating the Luanda process, and both sides welcomed the 4 August ceasefire and said it should be respected. This is direct evidence that Tshisekedi publicly supported a de-escalation agreement.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.1"]},{"title":"Readout of the Secretary-General’s meeting with H.E.
